layout: null
permalink: /llms.txt
---
{%- comment -%}
  AI 向けの案内（https://llmstxt.org/ の llms.txt）。README.md の見出し（## と ###）から各節へのリンクを作る。
  リンク先の ID は kramdown の自動 ID（小文字にし、記号を除き、空白を - にする）に合わせる
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- capture readme -%}{% include_relative README.md %}{%- endcapture -%}
{%- capture nl %}
{% endcapture -%}
{%- assign lines = readme | split: nl -%}
{%- assign in_code = false -%}
# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

## Docs

- [{{ site.title }}（全文）]({{ "/llms-full.txt" | relative_url }}): このドキュメントの本文全体を Markdown にしたもの
{%- for line in lines -%}
  {%- assign fence = line | slice: 0, 3 -%}
  {%- if fence == "```" -%}
    {%- if in_code -%}{%- assign in_code = false -%}{%- else -%}{%- assign in_code = true -%}{%- endif -%}
    {%- continue -%}
  {%- endif -%}
  {%- if in_code -%}{%- continue -%}{%- endif -%}
  {%- assign h3 = line | slice: 0, 4 -%}
  {%- assign h2 = line | slice: 0, 3 -%}
  {%- if h3 == "### " -%}
    {%- assign indent = "  " -%}
    {%- assign name = line | remove_first: "### " | strip -%}
  {%- elsif h2 == "## " -%}
    {%- assign indent = "" -%}
    {%- assign name = line | remove_first: "## " | strip -%}
  {%- else -%}
    {%- continue -%}
  {%- endif -%}
  {%- assign id = name | downcase | remove: "「" | remove: "」" | remove: "『" | remove: "』" | remove: "（" | remove: "）" | remove: "(" | remove: ")" | remove: "、" | remove: "。" | remove: "・" | remove: "：" | remove: ":" | remove: "？" | remove: "?" | remove: "！" | remove: "!" | strip | replace: " ", "-" %}
{{ indent }}- [{{ name }}]({{ "/" | relative_url }}#{{ id | url_encode }})
{%- endfor %}
